entities.summary: Hristo Slavov Kyuchukov or Christo Slavov Kütchukov(Bulgarian: Христо Славов Кючуков - is a Muslim Rom-Jambazi, born in Bulgaria. He was born with the Muslim name Hyusein Selimov Kyuchukov, but in 1980-s his name was changed by the communist government of Bulgaria during the "bulgarization" process towards the Muslims in Bulgaria. He is a leading specialist in the field of Romani language and education of Roma children in Europe. In December 2024 he took his Muslim name back and now his name is Huseyin Selim Kyuchuk.
